items.title: Conversational AI is going to transform education and deliver personalized tutoring at scale. But we have to build it right.
items.summary:
对话式 AI 将变革教育，实现大规模个性化辅导。但我们必须把它做对。

当前教育领域的大多数 AI 工具都在优化错误的目标：获取答案。但作业的意义不在于产出，而在于通过过程学会思考。我们应该构建帮助学生发展自身思考能力、而非把思考外包给 AI 的 AI。Gakku 正在这样做。

items.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers
items.summary: MIT 牵头的团队获得 ARPA-H STREAM 计划最高 5300 万美元资助，开发新一代除草剂替代方案，项目名为 PLOW。团队将用生成式 AI 模型预测可针对 EPSP synthase 等植物酶的分子或 siRNA，应对杂草抗药性问题，并优化合成成本、抗性风险和健康风险，预计第一年末完成首批 RNAi 候选的温室测试。

items.title: Anthropic reportedly plans to move forward with IPO plans
items.summary: 据 The Wall Street Journal 报道，Anthropic 将在本周设定估值区间，计划下周四或周五开始交易。部分机构投资者正推动估值低于上周讨论的 1.5 万亿美元目标，该数字已低于几个月前传闻的 2 万亿美元。报道还提到其主要竞争对手 OpenAI 上周融资 110 亿美元后估值约为 1.25 万亿美元，低于其最初寻求的 200 亿美元融资规模。

items.title: OpenAI lands an $11 billion funding round, but has to court dentists for more capital
items.summary: OpenAI 获得约 110 亿美元新融资，这是总额最高可达 200 亿美元一轮的首笔，投后估值 1.25 万亿美元。OpenAI 原计划以 1.4 万亿美元估值融资 300 亿美元，因 AI 板块抛售而缩水，投资方包括 Coatue、SoftBank、红杉、a16z 等，另在通过投行引入富裕个人投资者。

items.title: Crusoe sells troubled Wyoming data center project to Google
items.summary: Crusoe 确认将怀俄明州东南部一个未完工的数据中心项目出售给 Google，后者计划投资 170 亿美元开发该园区。Google 曾因成本和工期问题放弃成为该项目客户，原项目与 Tallgrass 合作规划最终扩展到 10 吉瓦电力容量。Crusoe 仍在为 Google 开发得州 Amarillo 附近的数据中心，并在 9 月完成 39 亿美元融资。

# 清华 Nature 封面团队创业，幂级智能连续完成三轮数亿元融资｜星连被投动态

星连资本· 2026年11月12日 11:16

 幂级智能聚焦世界模型的更底层问题：物理智能的最终来源是什么？

物理人工智能（Physical AI）基础模型公司幂级智能（DenseAI）完成第三轮融资，半年内累计融资金额达数亿元人民币，投资方包括北京、深圳头部国资、知名美元资本和顶级AI生态投资基金等。

幂级智能成立于2026年，是一支从清华大学自动化系走出来的顶尖AI团队，致力于打造下一代物理世界基础模型，以世界模型与密集学习（Dense Learning）为核心，推动人工智能从理解物理世界走向自主学习与持续进化。

在世界模型成为全球AI竞争热点的当下，幂级智能选择了一条差异化的技术路线：以大规模存量的、边际成本极低的真实物理数据作为智能来源，以原创的密集学习技术突破数据的稀疏度灾难和长尾难题，实现物理智能的高效率预训练、高水平后训练，最终让智能体具备在物理世界中持续进化的能力。

...

在幂级智能看来，规模化的数据是智能的来源，制约物理AI规模化发展的关键瓶颈，不仅是模型架构和算力，更是可规模化的真实物理数据。把物理世界中海量的、已经记录下来的、最真实的数据，通过密集学习，高效率的压缩成智能，这就是物理智能的诞生方式。

公司认为，物理世界模型的高价值数据源需要满足三个条件：足够低的边际成本、充分的真实物理信息，以及从第一天就具备大规模扩展的能力。围绕这一判断，幂级智能重点探索以世界为中心（World-centric）的真实交互视频数据，利用人类在工业生产、日常生活等真实场景中自然产生的物理活动，构建低成本、可持续扩展的预训练数据体系，降低对特定机器人本体和昂贵动作标注的依赖。

公司希望通过真实场景形成“场景产生数据、数据训练模型、模型反过来赋能场景”的持续增长飞轮，为物理世界模型建立真正可规模化的训练基础。据悉，公司世界模型已经在某全球机器人赛事中提供底层技术支撑，并开始在真实场景中商业化交付，初步完成产品市场验证。

AI原生芯片设计公司「泛函数」完成近亿元天使轮融资_投资界

# AI原生芯片设计公司「泛函数」完成近亿元天使轮融资

本轮融资将重点用于AI原生芯片设计垂类模型训练、全流程工具链迭代、芯片工程与AI算法核心团队扩充，以及客户联合交付与市场拓展。

 来源：投资界讯 更新于： 2026-11-11 16:10 1240字 

上海泛函数智能科技有限公司（下称“泛函数”）成立于2026年3月，总部位于上海徐汇西岸智塔，以AI为第 一性原理构建芯片设计平台。投资界（ID：pedaily2012）11月11日消息，AI原生芯片设计公司泛函数近日完成近亿元天使轮融资，由上海未来产业基金领投，上海信投、上海科创集团、富海重产基金、徐汇资本、宽桥恒松、无限基金联合投资。本轮融资将重点用于AI原生芯片设计垂类模型训练、全流程工具链迭代、芯片工程与AI算法核心团队扩充，以及客户联合交付与市场拓展。自2026年3月成立以来，泛函数在短短7个月内已经完成多轮融资。

泛函数创始人兼CEO周婧怡本科毕业于清华大学电子工程系，硕士毕业于卡耐基梅隆大学计算机系，长期深耕人工智能、芯片设计、EDA与GPU加速方向的研究，2026年归国创业。联合创始人兼CTO周菁本硕毕业于清华大学电子工程系，深耕人工智能与芯片设计。

...

泛函数平台接收自然语言形式的设计需求，依托多智能体协同，完成芯片架构规划、RTL逻辑代码生成、功能验证优化、物理版图布局、流片方案输出，最终输出可用于流片的GDS文件，覆盖芯片设计完整链路。

周婧怡表示，泛函数自研的面向芯片设计的垂类大模型现已形成商用。该模型配合泛函数的自研agent所形成的平台目前已经可以覆盖芯片设计全流程，技术上大幅减少工程师介入。从客户实际项目反馈来看，在质量上，平台输出的设计优于行业普通工程师水平，经过自迭代后，PPA可以达到顶 尖工程师的设计水准；在效率上，设计周期可缩短至原来的1/3以内。

# 飞拓星驰完成数千万美元天使轮融资，打造家庭AI互动娱乐入口

飞拓星驰近日完成数千万美元天使轮融资，本轮领投方分别是元生资本、江远投资，老股东日初资本、锋领资本等机构持续跟投。

 来源：投资界讯 更新于： 2026-11-12 14:15 2009字 

深圳市飞拓星驰科技有限公司（下称“飞拓星驰”）是一家AI互动娱乐公司，围绕AI游戏引擎、AI端侧模型和家庭娱乐硬件同步布局，希望打造一个能理解玩家、支持内容创作和多人互动的下一代家庭AI娱乐入口。投资界（ID：pedaily2012）11月12日消息，飞拓星驰近日完成数千万美元天使轮融资，本轮领投方分别是元生资本、江远投资，老股东日初资本、锋领资本等机构持续跟投。

飞拓星驰的AI团队均为95后，多名核心成员博士毕业于香港中文大学，曾在亚马逊、腾讯、华为、商汤从事研究与产品落地，负责过华为Agent平台和自动驾驶等核心项目，团队累计发表顶会论文上百篇。

...

飞拓星驰的技术布局围绕内容生产与实时交互展开。在交互侧，团队将自动驾驶与具身智能相关研究和工程经验，应用于人体动作、空间关系与实时反馈。领 先世界的AI端侧模型技术，使玩家无需依赖手柄和VR等外设，能够将高于120fps、小于3cm误差的人体3D姿态映射到游戏世界内，给玩家随心顺畅，自然沉浸的体感娱乐体验。在开发侧，公司通过AI管线辅助原型、资产、场景与交互逻辑制作，缩短从创意到可玩版本的验证周期。专用硬件则为算法运行与游戏体验提供统一的设备环境，让内容、感知与交互能够协同优化。

...

飞拓星驰将于CES 2027首次公开展示产品，首期面向北美家庭市场。随着AI从辅助内容生产进一步走向实时交互，公司希望让AI游戏机可以成为家庭中能够持续更新内容、理解不同玩家，并连接共同娱乐体验的AI入口。

# 阜时科技完成超4亿元C4轮融资，加速物理AI空间感知芯片布局

11月12日消息，阜时科技完成超4亿元C4轮融资，投资方含多家上市公司及专业投资机构，该公司是激光雷达核心芯片研发的行业领先企业。

 来源：投资界讯 更新于： 2026-11-12 10:52 1055字 

阜时科技有限公司（下称“阜时科技”）致力于激光雷达核心芯片及多种机器视觉解决方案研发，行业首家发布及量产面阵SPAD激光雷达接收芯片及解决方案。投资界（ID：pedaily2012）11月12日消息，阜时科技近日正式完成超4亿元C4轮融资交割。本轮投资方包括信通电子（001388.SZ）、精测电子（300567.SZ）、华睿投资、汇宁投资、兴银资产、青稞资本及中欧新能源汽车基金等上市公司、产业资本及专业投资机构。

阜时科技依托自主研发的SPAD（单光子雪崩二极管）芯片与全固态光扫描技术，布局单芯片RGBD技术，致力于在单颗芯片上实现彩色图像与深度信息的原生融合，让每个像素同时具备“色彩”与“深度”，从根源上消除多传感器融合的误差盲区。相比传统二维成像，该技术推动机器视觉向三维空间感知升级，为智能汽车、具身智能及工业智能提供新一代空间感知核心部件，计划于2027年推进产业化。

目前，公司全固态激光雷达SPAD芯片已实现主流车企车规级前装量产，累计出货突破百万颗。在此基础上，阜时科技持续深化SPAD器件研发，布局RGBD一体芯片技术，并不断拓展底层光电芯片技术的应用边界，为物理AI时代的空间感知需求提供核心技术支撑。

2026-05-09

## 造物时代完成数亿元A轮融资

近日，全球消费级CNC领军企业造物时代（Makera）完成数亿元A轮融资，由华映资本、北京市人工智能产业投资基金联合领投，元禾璞华、中科创星、清科创投跟投，老股东启明创投持续超额跟投。 CNC，全称Computer Numerical Control，即用电脑程序指挥机器对材料进行精密切割、雕刻和铣削。相比于3D打印是用塑料和树脂层层堆叠的增材制造，CNC是从一整块材料上精准削掉多余部分的减材制造。 自成立起，造物时代就专注于把工业级加工能力搬上大众桌面：过去，受限于体积庞大、操作门槛高、环境要求严苛等因素，CNC只能在工厂车间里，即便存在少量桌面级产品，也大多处于“半成品”状态，需要用户具备极强的工程背景和组装能力，而造物时代要改变这一现状。

2026-05-09

## 鹰瞰智翼完成数千万元Pre-A轮融资

近日，专注于具身智能仿生扑翼机器人的深圳鹰瞰智翼科技有限公司（下称 “鹰瞰智翼”）宣布，公司已完成Pre-A轮数千万元融资，本轮为元禾原点独家投资。本轮资金将主要用于核心技术研发、流体仿真引擎迭代、消费级与产业级产品矩阵完善及商业化落地拓展。 此前，鹰瞰智翼已连续完成两轮融资，累计融资金额达数千万元。其中，种子轮由奇绩创坛独家战略投资；天使轮由启高资本领投，老股东奇绩创坛持续加注，菡源资产（交大母基金）跟投。

## 共绩科技完成近亿元的Pre-A轮融资

近日，共绩科技完成近亿元的Pre-A轮融资，本轮由春华创投、彼岸时代联合领投，力合中科、阿尔法公社跟投，资金将主要用于技术研发投入和市场拓展。该公司此前还分别获得水木创投、奇绩创坛、新进创投等多家机构投资。 共绩科技成立于2023年，核心团队源自清华大学。公司从创立之初便锚定了一个核心判断：随着AI应用走向普及，推理场景的算力需求将呈现剧烈波动，而现有的粗放式算力供给模式（如长期包租、整机租赁）无法满足这一精细化需求，从而形成了“弹性、低价、稳定”的行业不可能三角。

近日，北京脑回录科技有限公司（Nanoloop）宣布完成千万元种子+轮融资，本轮由南山战新投领投，此前，公司于2024年获得奇绩创坛种子轮投资。本轮资金将主要用于核心技术迭代、产品工程化落地及市场拓展，加速推进运动场景非侵入式脑机接口（BCI）穿戴设备的规模化商用。 脑回录的创新在于，将AI模型、脑机接口技术、定制化运动诱发范式及高精度运动数据标注融为一体的全链条解决方案，同时引入生物力学捕捉与生物生化技术作为核心标签，彻底打破行业瓶颈，重塑运动监测新范式。

...

近日，北京纯锂新能源科技有限公司（以下简称纯锂新能源）宣布完成数千万元Pre-A+轮融资，投资方为亦庄国投，云道资本担任独家财务顾问，资金将用于产品研发、市场拓展及产线落地。

2026-05-08

近日，具身智能灵巧手公司临界点（AGILINK）完成数亿元新一轮融资，本轮融资由头部互联网大厂领投，BV百度风投、云锋基金等顶级资本参与，Synstellation Capital、均胜电子、龙旗科技、上汽金控等产业资本共同投资，同时引入C资本、沃赋、慕华科创等多家财务机构。老股东高瓴创投、蓝驰创投继续超额认购。值得一提的是，公司注册一个月内，连续完成多轮融资。

据了解，本轮融资主要用于加速灵巧手与夹爪产品线的研发，完善控制系统与开发工具链，推动具身智能灵巧操作大模型的研发，面向产业客户的交付能力建设，确保灵巧手产品能够实现快速规模化部署。 

上海临界点创新智能科技有限公司成立于2026年1月，团队背景覆盖机器人本体、控制算法、系统工程与产业化经验，目标是在稳定性、可用性与规模化交付能力上，推动灵巧手从“实验室设备”走向“工程化产品”。

临界点将继续专注于灵巧操作这一核心技术，围绕具身智能技术的研发、数据采集、人形机器人与工业场景的应用，逐步构建可复用、可扩展的产品与技术体系。在具身智能快速演进的背景下，临界点希望通过持续投入与稳健推进，成为连接算法、硬件与真实世界应用的关键一环，推动全球具身智能生态的建设，赋能全球制造与机器人产业。

# 2026-01-13 前阿里钉钉最年轻副总裁AI项目攀峰智能获数千万投资， 致力于打造面向未来电商时代的AI Shopify 

来源：企业供图

 本轮融资资金将主要用于产品和AI能力打造、用户增长和AI Native团队的加速构建，快速推进全球首个面向超级个体的内容电商Agent基建。 

近日，由阿里钉钉最年轻的副总裁王铭创立的攀峰智能（K2 Lab）宣布完成数千万元的种子轮融资，由云时资本独家投资，本轮融资资金将主要用于产品和AI能力打造、用户增长和AI Native团队的加速构建，快速推进全球首个面向超级个体的内容电商Agent基建。

K2 Lab的首款产品，全球首个全自动帮达人赚钱的商业Agentic AI——Moras，通过“洞察-创作-分析”，打造了Agent最小单元的在线强化学习飞轮，实现从帮助达人理解内容电商、行业洞察到选品推荐、脚本生成、多镜头视频制作、智能剪辑、商业分析的端到端自动化闭环。

...

Moras的长期愿景是构建多模态的“AI Shopify”，通过AaaS（Agent-as-a-Service）模式为每一个超级个体提供Agent基建，协助超级个体在AI能力底座下更好地管理流量和管理供应链实现商业变现，后续Moras还会陆续推出互动涨粉、情感沟通、私域营销、自动投放等流量管理Agent和物流金融、柔性定制、IP联名等供应链管理Agent，并在通用基建后为头部超级个体打造围绕审美、品味和生活方式的“垂直Agent入口”。积累用户数据，强化用户心智，支持超级个体打造去中心化的生活方式电商入口，最终进化成为新时代需要的的“AI Shopify”

...

据悉，Moras已于年前启动邀测，并计划2026年一季度开启商业化推广和用户增长体系建设。本轮融资后，Moras将通过持续磨合产品、改进算法，强化“洞察-创作-分析”的Multi-Agent架构，并建立LoRA模型矩阵和在线强化学习框架，26年完成快速增长，持续完善KOC生态AI基建。

# 融资丨嘉腾机器人完成数千万战略融资，卡位具身智能“物理基座”

睿兽分析·今天 09:49

由上市公司和而泰（002402.SZ）领投、道禾基金（LP是东方精工、乐聚机器人和道禾自有资金）、金木资本跟投。

近日，嘉腾机器人宣布完成数千万战略融资，由上市公司和而泰（002402.SZ）领投、道禾基金（LP是东方精工、乐聚机器人和道禾自有资金）、金木资本跟投。 

作为工业具身智能移动底盘核心供应商，嘉腾机器人依托二十余年高端制造场景的深厚积淀，已累计服务近百家世界500强企业，完成超2000个项目交付，沉淀了2.7亿小时的工业现场运行数据。公司核心产品具身智能底盘具备360°全向移动能力，可在VLA/VLM大模型统一指挥下实现任意方向精准运动，目前月交付量达150至200台，已正式进入批量出货阶段。同时，公司基于自有底盘积极拓展具身应用开发，与乐聚机器人等头部企业携手推进双臂15公斤负载人形机器人在工业场景中的PoC验证。此外，覆盖5公斤至220吨全负载、500余种SKU的AGV/AMR智能搬运业务，作为工业场景理解、客户粘性与数据积累的基石，为嘉腾具身智能产品提供了强劲的底层支撑。

...

在技术自研与工程化能力方面， 嘉腾机器人自研iCore工业智能基座，涵盖高稳定性核心零部件、高精度导航控制算法、大规模AI调度系统及多场景差异化数据采集支持，累计持有700多项专利及软件著作权。量产层面，AGV年产能达1万台，具身底盘已获头部行业客户认可，公司拥有数百项Checklist及200项可靠性验证清单，确保稳定交付。值得一提的是，公司还储备了航天级技术能力——2023年入围中国载人航天工程办公室载人月球车方案征集并进入专家评审环节，同时为西安交大载人月球车仿真基地提供仿真测试车辆，极端环境适应技术持续反哺工业产品可靠性。

在具身智能产业链中，嘉腾卡位“物理基座”环节。二十余年高难度工业场景沉淀、全球化合规壁垒及规模化制造能力，构成了新进入者难以跨越的门槛。

面向未来，嘉腾机器人规划了清晰的“三步走”节奏：稳住现有跨国大客户营收、扩产底盘为近期重点；完善iCore基座、联合大模型伙伴迭代方案为中期抓手；打通全栈软硬件、进军航天特种场景为长期方向，致力于成为全球具身智能移动底盘领域的核心供应商。

# 融资丨昉擎科技完成A1轮近10亿融资，跻身百亿估值独角兽阵营

·2026-08-03

此轮融资后公司估值超过百亿元人民币，正式成为百亿估值“独角兽”公司。

国产新一代人工智能计算系统企业昉擎科技宣布完成A1轮融资，此轮融资后公司估值超过百亿元人民币，正式成为百亿估值“独角兽”公司。

昉擎科技本轮融资由上海徐汇区国资平台徐汇资本、珠海市国资旗下珠海科技产业集团两大地方产业国资战略投资，中金资本、国泰海通创意投资两大头部券商系基金、尚势资本、水木创投、明嘉资本等产业资本参与投资。老股东阵列中，钧山资本大额加注，多维资本、华业天成、临港科创投、建发新兴、三七互娱等同步超额追投。

昉擎科技于2023年初成立，公司由行业内资深团队创立，专注于基于分离式架构的智能计算系统研发，仅用约三年时间成为百亿估值“独角兽”企业，在近半年内连续宣布完成Pre A、Pre-A+轮及A1轮共3轮融资。业内人士分析，多地国资、国有券商资本、产业投资方与深耕企业已久的老股东同步重仓布局，体现了各地政府及国家级资本对国产智能计算系统的战略重视，以及一级市场头部机构对昉擎科技底层技术原创性、产品落地确定性与长期产业价值的高度认可。

...

昉擎科技表示，本轮融资资金将主要用于自研芯片与系统的研发、规模化量产、软件生态建设及高端人才引进。

...

昉擎科技是一家专注于新一代智能计算系统研发的硬科技企业。公司基于原创的分离式架构，4D Memory理论，自主研发芯片、硬件系统与软件栈，致力于为全球人工智能产业提供低延迟、高扩展性的下一代智能计算系统。

昉擎科技创新提出了“上下文相关”（Context Aware）与“上下文无关”（Context Free）解耦的分布式 AI 计算架构，并认为这是面向未来的系统级创新，旨在解决传统算力架构适配模型迭代滞后、通信开销高及延迟等问题。

# 融资丨AI记忆迎来融资潮，上海头部团队再获亿元融资

·2026-07-20

记忆张量

上海人工智能

记忆分层架构大模型研发商

最新融资：Pre-A轮|近亿人民币|2026-07-20

本轮融资由华为哈勃、荣耀战投、商汤国香、深创投、和玉资本共同参与

2026年7月，记忆张量MemTensor（以下简称“记忆张量”）宣布完成亿元 Pre-A 轮融资。本轮融资由华为哈勃、荣耀战投、商汤国香、深创投、和玉资本共同参与，将进一步支持公司在 MemOS 记忆操作系统、记忆增强 Agent 和记忆原生通用基座模型方向的研发投入与产业落地。

本轮融资获得了来自产业方、国资平台和专业投资机构的共同支持。华为哈勃、荣耀战投、商汤国香、深创投、和玉资本的加入，覆盖了 AI 基础设施、智能终端、模型与产业应用、硬科技投资和长期技术资本等多个方向。面向下一阶段，记忆张量MemTensor 将继续推进 MemOS 记忆操作系统迭代、Agent 和记忆基础设施产品化、重点产业场景落地，以及基于记忆原生驱动的通用基座模型训练，推动长期记忆与持续学习能力进入更广泛的 AI 应用和产业系统。

记忆张量长期围绕“大模型如何具备长期记忆、经验沉淀、持续学习和可治理演化能力”这一核心技术命题展开研发。公司认为，AI 正在从一次性生成和单轮推理，进入 Agent、AI 终端、企业智能体和工业 AI 长期运行的新阶段。下一阶段 AI 系统的关键竞争，不只是模型参数更大、上下文更长或推理能力更强，而是谁能让 AI 在长期交互中持续记住任务背景、用户偏好、组织经验和历史状态。

items.title: With $720M round, Britain's Fractile gets a leg up in the race for AI chips | TechCrunch
items.snippet:
With $720M round, Britain's Fractile gets a leg up in the race for AI chips | TechCrunch

Image Credits: Sam Barnes/Sportsfile for Web Summit via Getty Images

# With $720M round, Britain’s Fractile gets a leg up in the race for AI chips

 Anna Heim 

11:34 AM PST · November 11, 2026

Fractile, a British startup developing AI chips, has raised a $720 million Series C backed by Britain’s Sovereign AI Fund with hopes of “ensuring the U.K. has a greater stake in the hardware that will underpin its future economy,” its government stated.

Alongside the likes of Axelera, Etched, and OLIX, this makes Fractile one of the top-funded startup players in the race for purpose-built AI chips. Such chips are one of several avenues being explored to reduce the cost of inference — aka using increasingly demanding AI models in production. 

However, Fractile seeks to go beyond hardware with a full-stack approach that also includes a machine learning compiler to maximize the speed at which LLMs will get executed on its chips.

As a result, the company frames itself as a frontier AI company, and its latest round led by Thrive Capital, Founders Fund, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Redpoint was priced accordingly. According to the British government, the valuation was “over £5 billion” — quite possibly $7 billion, a figure reported both by the Financial Times and a Reuters source.

...

In a LinkedIn post, Fractile CEO Walter Goodwin wrote that “there is still a lot of work ahead” for the company, and that the new funding will enable the startup to “ship [its] first chips and systems next year.”

items.title: Norwest pushes deeper into AI with new $4B fund | TechCrunch
items.snippet:
Norwest pushes deeper into AI with new $4B fund | TechCrunch

Image Credits: Norwest

# Norwest pushes deeper into AI with new $4B fund

 Kirsten Korosec 

7:18 AM PST · November 12, 2026

Norwest, a firm backed solely by Wells Fargo, has raised a $4 billion fund as it sets out to invest more in AI. This is the eighteenth fund for the 65-year-old multi-stage investment firm, and its largest to date.

The fund will be invested across various sectors and multiple countries, notably the United States, India, and Israel. But the big story here is AI, and Norwest’s plans to expand its investment in this area.

Norwest said Thursday it aims to capitalize on AI startups developing products and services across core industries such as consumer, healthcare, and technology. The investment firm, which has backed Plaid, Spotify, Uber, and Vuori, said it will continue to expand its investments in physical AI, voice AI, agentic cybersecurity, and aerospace.

...

Some of the firm’s recent investments reflect this strategy. For instance, the firm invested in Coval, which builds tools to test and evaluate AI agents, and Generalist AI, a startup that has developed AI foundation models for robots.

Since the launch of its seventeenth fund, a $3 billion raise that closed in 2024, the firm has made more than 87 investments.

# Siri co-founder backs Helix for its voice ID tech

 Ivan Mehta 

7:02 AM PST · November 11, 2026

For years, websites have relied on technology like CAPTCHA to prove that the user on the other end is human. More recently, social media platforms have turned to photos or videos to verify users’ identities. Now, a startup called Helix is betting that voice technology can do the same job, without requiring users to hand over sensitive personal information.

The voice technology, which can run directly on a user’s device, has attracted backing from Siri co-founder Dag Kittlaus, who will also act as an adviser.

The company raised $6.2 million in funding in a round led by Chicago Ventures, with participation from BAM Ventures, Aglaé Ventures, Corazon Capital, Press On Ventures, Tusk Ventures, Yonder Ventures, Rule 30, and Brown Angel Group.

The startup was founded by Alex Oberg, Anna Dorofiyenko, and Mike Hall in 2025. Oberg previously worked at Ticketmaster, which acquired his startup; Dorofiyenko led data science teams at Live Nation and Zillow; and Hall has worked at Nike and Tinder, where he helped develop the initial matching algorithm.

...

Its core technology can run directly on a device to determine whether someone is human and estimate their age. The company is also running pilots to explore whether voice can be used as a biomarker to detect conditions such as drunkenness or distress.

The company can deploy its technology to replace or supplement CAPTCHA and help block bot attacks. Helix said that because its model can run locally even on an iPhone 13, the cost of deploying the technology is minimal. The startup said one of its customers is Zeel, an in-home healthcare provider that uses Helix’s tech to verify the identities of providers visiting customers’ homes.

items.snippet:
Plurai wants to help AI agents work better using the same approach that helped get self-driving cars to roads | TechCrunch

Image Credits: Plurai / Guy Hamoy

# Plurai wants to help AI agents work better using the same approach that helped get self-driving cars to roads

 Tim Fernholz 

6:00 AM PST · November 11, 2026

AI agents are all the rage, but they’re not quite as capable as their purveyors would have you believe. 

Efforts to benchmark agents doing complex tasks show that they aren’t typically reliable enough to function without close supervision. LiveBench 2.0 shows Claude Fable 5.2 and ChatGPT-6 Astra succeeding on 82.9 and 75.6 out of 100 tasks, respectively, and an effort by the AI infrastructure company EON to test agents in a simulated corporate environment found the most successful model tested, Claude Opus 4.8, performed tasks at 76.8% accuracy.

# AI hardware startup Nominal triples valuation to $3B in 8 months

Nominal, a four-year-old, Austin-based startup that offers an AI platform purpose-built for engineering and testing complex hardware, like aircraft, nuclear reactors, and smart factories, has raised another big round of financing that triples its valuation. On Monday, it announced a $240 million Series C at a $3 billion valuation led by Lightspeed Venture Partners and co-led by Insight Partners.

This follows the company’s announcement in March of a $155 million Series B extension at a $1 billion valuation, led by Trae Stephens at Founders Fund. That round was a “preemptive” deal — meaning an offer initiated by the investor, not the startup. Other investors in the company include Sequoia, General Catalyst, and Lux Capital.

Nominal says that it has 80 commercial and government organizations as customers. One of its key customers is Anduril, the defense company co-founded by Stephens. Nominal also won a government contract in October when the Air Force selected it for a $71.2 million Strategic Funding Increase (STRATFI) investment, which is a program that requires matching funds from outside the Air Force.

# Proximal Ventures raises debut fund to back startups bringing AI to drug development

 Marina Temkin 

12:47 PM PST · November 10, 2026

While established venture firms continue to attract capital, first-time fund managers are facing one of the toughest fundraising environments in years. But that didn’t stop Sahir Raoof, a former SignalFire investor and executive at two healthcare startups, from raising $27.5 million for his first solo VC fund.

Raoof’s firm, Proximal Ventures, is betting that AI can transform the tools, infrastructure, and services that support drug development.

Pharmaceutical companies have historically outsourced various stages of drug development to specialized service providers, from synthesizing thousands of molecular compounds and figuring out how to manufacture drugs at scale to analyzing clinical trial data.

...

Raoof believes AI could automate much of that work, creating an opportunity for startups to capture billions of dollars in pharmaceutical industry spending. By using AI, these companies could deliver the same services at a lower cost and in significantly less time, he said.

Some of the most valuable applications of AI so far have been in service-oriented industries like law and finance, Raoof said. He sees similar opportunities in pharmaceutical services.

Proximal plans to invest in pre-seed and seed-stage startups, writing checks from $500,000 to $1.5 million. The firm has already backed seven startups, including ChronicleBio, co-founded by former OpenAI executive Fidji Simo, which uses AI to analyze biological and medical data to better understand chronic diseases and identify potential treatments.

图源/视觉中国

作者丨欧雪

编辑丨袁斯来

硬氪获悉，原生通用人工智能（AGI）架构芯片研发商——通芯人工智能科技（北京）有限公司（下称“通芯智能”）成立半年已连续完成数亿元种子轮及天使轮融资。融资由清华校友种子基金、北京通用人工智能研究院、松霖科技、平治信息、暗物智能以及豫资涨泉、普超资本、青创伯乐等财务投资人共同参与，集聚产业资本、头部科技VC和财务资本。资金将主要用于芯片流片前的核心架构设计及研发。

通芯智能成立于2026年4月，由人工智能科学家、通研院院长、北大和清华讲席教授朱松纯发起，依托北京通用人工智能研究院（通研院）孵化。

公司创始核心团队的平均芯片从业经验超过20年，骨干来自海光、百度、字节、阿里等头部芯片与AI团队，创始核心技术团队毕业于清华、北大、中科院、UCLA等院校，完整走过架构定义、前端设计、后端设计、流片、量产交付全链路，科学家团队覆盖大模型、世界模型、物理智能等AI全技术栈。创始人王海洋师从中国计算机事业的奠基人之一夏培肃院士，是龙芯CPU创始成员，曾任海光4代芯片架构负责人，GPU独角兽联创，拥有25年芯片研发及15年SoC架构设计经历，累计持有近百项国内外发明专利，在CPU、GPU、GPGPU等大芯片方向具备丰富的研发和量产经验。

...

因此，在当前大语言模型向AGI过渡的产业节点上，通芯智能选择了一条“不做GPU改良版，直接围绕CUV认知架构设计芯片”的差异化路线。

通芯智能的芯片设计理念源自朱松纯教授提出的认知（Cognition）、能力（Utility）、价值（Value）三维联合空间，即CUV架构。基于该理论底座，通芯智能以自研的Vector+Tensor+AGI Core三单元架构为基础，打造既支持向量、张量计算，又为物理、社交智能等提供原生支持的高性价比芯片。朱松纯教授表示：“通用人工智能的竞争，本质是架构之争。通芯要做的是把这条路落到硅上：以芯片适配AGI的认知架构，与‘通通’等智能体和大模型协同，构成端到端解决方案。”

...

据王海洋介绍，公司第一代芯片定位为高性价比的推理芯片，同时支持云端模型工厂和端侧物理智能，端侧对标英伟达的Thor系列，云端对标英伟达B300系列。

...

硬氪进一步了解到，公司成立三个月即完成架构设计和立项，现已进入芯片设计阶段，计划12月初展开FPGA原型验证工作，届时将展示阶段性成果。

在商业化落地方面，通芯智能规划了三个市场布局并已初步达成规模合作意向：第一，依托通研院体系及产业战略伙伴，在AGI通用智能体领域展开合作；第二，面向大模型智算集群和Token工厂，与整机厂商及地方智算中心合作，提供高性价比Token算力；第三，面向物理智能与具身机器人，提供端侧大算力推理芯片。

# Nebuly raises €18.95 million to help enterprises measure the real economic value of AI agents

By Rahul Raj

November 12, 2026

Nebuly, a Turin- and New York-based startup that helps enterprises measure the return on investment from their AI agents, has raised €18.95 million ($21 million) in a Series A funding round.

The round was led by Planven, with participation from Exor Ventures, Tenacity Capital, TGVG Capital, and Fastweb+Vodafone via Founders Factory, alongside turning investors and angels. CDP Venture Capital SGR also participated in this round through its Artificial Intelligence Fund and Digital Transition Fund, backed by the European Union’s NextGenerationEU programme.

...

Founded in 2022 by Francesco Signorato, Julien Roux, and Diego Fiori, Nebuly analyses what AI agents actually do inside an organisation, across both employee-facing tools and customer-facing assistants. It consolidates its analysis into a single view, with internal deployments measured in the form of efficiency gains such as hours saved and capacity freed up, while also offering insights into new tasks the teams can take on.

For customer-facing AI, it tracks revenue influenced by agents and surfaces signals such as churn risk and upsell opportunities. The platform connects to agents businesses already use, including those built on Claude, ChatGPT, and Microsoft Copilot, and customers can choose to run on-premises or within a customer’s private cloud.

...

The Series A funding round follows multiple six-figure contracts across telecommunications, automotive, industrial manufacturing, luxury, healthcare, and technology. Its customers include Oura, Iveco Group, Fastweb+Vodafone, CNH, and Zeiss.

Nebuly plans to deploy the new capital to scale its go-to-market teams across the United States and Europe, while continuing to develop its platform. The company wants to become the industry standard for measuring the business value of AI, a capability seen as essential as more businesses see

# Munich-based SE3 secures €27.04 million to bring spatial intelligence to Europe’s autonomous defence systems

By Rahul Raj

November 12, 2026

SE3, a Munich-based spatial intelligence provider for autonomous systems, today announced that it has raised €27.04 million ($30 million) in Series A funding. 

The round was led by Accel, with participation from Keen, Lakestar, and Seedcamp. The company plans to use this capital to grow its engineering, commercial, and operations teams and prepare to fulfil additional contracts as it scales. It also intends to strengthen its presence in Germany and Ukraine, open an office in the UK, and plans to expand further across Europe. Its immediate focus remains defence, with plans to explore robotics, emergency response and other civilian applications for demanding environments from 2027.

...

SE3 was founded in 2023 by Lukas Köstler (CEO), Simon Klenk (CTO), and Chief Science Officer Professor Daniel Cremers. It spun out of Cremers’ computer vision lab at the Technical University of Munich (TUM), where Köstler and Klenk were working on PhDs in computer vision and robotics. Professor Cremers holds TUM’s chair for computer vision and AI, and is a recipient of the Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Prize, Germany’s most prestigious research award. # 2026-02-11 聚焦具身智能灵巧操作底层能力建设，临界点再获数亿元融资 

来源：图虫

 头部互联网大厂领投，BV百度风投、云锋基金等顶级资本参与，Synstellation Capital、均胜电子、龙旗科技、上汽金控等产业资本共同投资。 

来源：猎云网

近日，具身智能灵巧手公司临界点（AGILINK）完成数亿元新一轮融资，本轮融资由头部互联网大厂领投，BV百度风投、云锋基金等顶级资本参与，Synstellation Capital、均胜电子、龙旗科技、上汽金控等产业资本共同投资，同时引入C资本、沃赋、慕华科创等多家财务机构。老股东高瓴创投、蓝驰创投继续超额认购。值得一提的是，公司注册一个月内，连续完成多轮融资。

据了解，本轮融资主要用于加速灵巧手与夹爪产品线的研发，完善控制系统与开发工具链，推动具身智能灵巧操作大模型的研发，面向产业客户的交付能力建设，确保灵巧手产品能够实现快速规模化部署。 

上海临界点创新智能科技有限公司成立于2026年1月，团队背景覆盖机器人本体、控制算法、系统工程与产业化经验，目标是在稳定性、可用性与规模化交付能力上，推动灵巧手从“实验室设备”走向“工程化产品”。

临界点将继续专注于灵巧操作这一核心技术，围绕具身智能技术的研发、数据采集、人形机器人与工业场景的应用，逐步构建可复用、可扩展的产品与技术体系。在具身智能快速演进的背景下，临界点希望通过持续投入与稳健推进，成为连接算法、硬件与真实世界应用的关键一环，推动全球具身智能生态的建设，赋能全球制造与机器人产业。

# 2026-02-02 AI医药研发解决方案提供商深度智耀完成6000万美元新一轮融资 

来源：图虫

 凯泰资本、信宸资本、金镒资本，老股东鼎晖百孚和新鼎资本共同投资。 

来源：猎云网

近日，AI医药研发解决方案提供商深度智耀（DIP）完成6000万美元新一轮融资，本轮融资由凯泰资本、信宸资本、金镒资本，老股东鼎晖百孚和新鼎资本共同投资。

北京深度智耀科技有限公司成立于2018年4月，是AI驱动型药物研发与商业化平台，致力于通过AI重塑药物临床研发全流程。公司已服务全球数千家药企与生物科技公司，作为“AI定义临床”的倡导者，深度智耀正通过技术赋能，大幅缩短新药上市周期，降低研发成本，造福全球患者。

深度智耀提出的“电子神经元单点无效论”与基于脑科学理念构建的“原子化智能体”协同系统，正在将AI从辅助工具升级为具备专业意识、可协同进化的“数字科学家团队”。这一范式跃迁，正是AI在制药领域走向通用化（AGI）的关键路径。该平台的核心亮点在于其类人的自主进化机制。通过假设‑验证‑反思‑修正的闭环，系统能不断识别知识盲区与逻辑漏洞，并完成对智能体的自主优化与重构。这种自我迭代能力，结合四层防护机制带来的99.9%工业级精度，使AI能可靠地应用于临床试验方案设计等严肃医疗场景，也为平台的长期价值积累奠定了坚实基础。

深度智耀近期推出的“Protocol Rehearsal（方案预演智能体）”，通过在虚拟空间中完整模拟临床试验，实现对入组、脱落、资源消耗等关键节点的精准预测。这一创新不仅有望大幅降低临床开发的不确定性与成本，更标志着AI正从“流程优化”走向“决策前置”，推动新药研发向“智能决策密集型”模式转型。

来源：图虫

 本轮融资资金将重点用于机器人本体、多模态大模型、通用机器人“大小脑”、世界模型等核心能力建设，以及东南亚等海外市场的业务拓展与本地化布局。 

来源：猎云网

近日，人工智能企业宇泛智能宣布完成Pre-IPO+轮融资，折合人民币5.13亿元。本轮融资由温州苍南县“山海实业集团”与马来西亚“Crewstone International (CSI)”联合投资，老股东“博将资本”继参与宇泛智能B2轮、C2轮投资之后，此次Pre-IPO+轮继续加码。 

本轮融资资金将重点用于机器人本体、多模态大模型、通用机器人“大小脑”、世界模型等核心能力建设，以及东南亚等海外市场的业务拓展与本地化布局，进一步夯实公司在AI2.0阶段的技术积累与全球化发展基础。

宇泛智能创立于2014年，公司致力于通过人工智能与机器人技术，将人类从“3D”（Dull、Dirty、Dangerous）的工作中解放出来。

在AI1.0阶段，宇泛智能以人脸识别技术为起点，逐步拓展至多类视觉感知与行为识别算法，并实现从AI算法到智能硬件的全栈布局，构建了AI与电子工程深度融合的技术体系。AI2.0阶段，宇泛智能持续推进以多模态大模型为核心的系统性布局，推动智能能力从“视觉感知”向“感知—推理—决策—执行”的闭环能力演进。目前，公司已在端侧多模态大模型、空间认知模型、具身智能硬件与系统级控制架构等方向展开深度研发，为新一代通用机器人及复杂场景智能体的规模化应用奠定基础。

# 人格智能完成数千万元种子轮融资

 原文链接 2026-01-12 

 近日，AI 初创公司 Humanify（人格智能）宣布完成数千万元种子轮融资。本轮融资由五源资本领投，奇绩创坛（陆奇博士）跟投。本轮资金将主要用于模型和操作系统研发、扩大团队，加速智能在真实场景的落地。 Humanify 成立于 2024 年，专注于开发下一代 human-like 模型与 AI 原生操作系统。不同于以功能效率为中心的工具型 AI 公司，Humanify 从一开始便将关注点放在 AI 的“类人认知与自主意识”上，致力于将类人智能真正融入人类生活，探索智能在真实生活场景中的长期存在形态。

items.title: 中国AI，越来越烧钱
items.snippet:
中国AI，越来越烧钱-虎嗅网

2026-11-11 14:31

# 中国AI，越来越烧钱

奇帆商业

本文来自微信公众号： 奇帆商业 ，编辑：陆垚，制图：奇帆商业，作者：钱喆

11月9日，SpaceX一项预计投资240亿美元的计划浮出水面。按照公开听证文件，这家公司准备在美国得克萨斯州建设燃气发电厂和超级计算中心。

项目尚未获批，但一家以航天业务闻名的科技公司，已经开始考虑自己解决算力设施的电力供应。

微软、谷歌、亚马逊和Meta正在持续增加AI资本开支。芯片、服务器和数据中心之外，电力供应逐渐成为影响项目进度和建设成本的重要因素。

AI竞争的投入范围，已经从计算设备延伸到能源基础设施。

中国互联网大厂同样在扩大投资。阿里、腾讯和百度持续采购芯片、扩建算力设施，AI业务收入也在增长。先进芯片供应受限、模型服务竞争激烈，加上部分成熟业务增长放缓，中国企业承担着与美国科技公司不同的经营压力。

越来越多的资金流向AI，财务报表开始呈现出另一面：业务收入的增长，未必跟得上投资的速度。

## 2080亿元，花在了哪里

9月17日，研究机构荣鼎集团发布了一份关于中国AI融资的报告。研究覆盖13家企业，包括阿里、腾讯、百度、华为、电信运营商、模型公司及独立数据中心运营商。报告估算，这些企业2026年的AI基础设施资本开支将达到9320亿元，同比增长103%；2027年可能超过1.2万亿元。

中国AI基础设施投资规模仍只有美国的15%至20%，资金压力却已经出现在互联网大厂的财务报表中。荣鼎集团统计，2026年上半年，阿里、腾讯和百度合计资本开支达到2080亿元，同期合计自由现金流为负160亿元。

三家大厂半年投入超过2000亿元，经营活动产生的现金已不足以覆盖同期资本性投资。这些资本开支并非全部用于AI，自由现金流转负也不代表企业亏损。真正值得分析的是，持续扩大的基础设施投资，开始改变互联网公司的资金使用方式。

...

腾讯的资金占用呈现出另一种形式。荣鼎集团援引腾讯披露的信息称，2026年第二季度，腾讯约510亿元AI相关预付款计入经营现金流，当季资本开支约590亿元。

预付款与资本开支属于不同会计项目，不能直接相加。它们共同反映出一个采购特点：为了锁定先进芯片和计算资源，企业可能在设备交付、资产确认之前就支付大笔资金。

...

百度的处境更为复杂。2026年第二季度，百度AI驱动业务收入125亿元，同比增长25%；AI云基础设施收入73亿元，同比增长50%。传统在线营销业务仍在下滑，基础模型、云计算和自动驾驶却需要持续投入。

...

## 谁能把AI养下去

资本市场正在为中国AI提供越来越多的资金。

荣鼎集团统计，2026年前八个月，智谱、MiniMax、DeepSeek和月之暗面等主要模型公司通过私募融资、上市及定向增发等渠道获得的资金，合计达到1790亿元。2025年，这些公司的私募股权和风险投资融资规模约为90亿元，两组数据的融资渠道范围并不完全相同。

大厂也开始调整资金安排。荣鼎集团研究指出，部分互联网公司减少股票回购、出售短期投资资产，并增加借款，为AI基础设施投资腾出资金。字节跳动则在9月获得一笔296亿美元的银团贷款，据路透社报道，大部分资金预计将用于AI相关项目。

AI竞争正在从企业内部的研发预算，延伸到银行贷款、股票市场和长期资产融资。技术能力决定企业需要投入多少资金，融资能力则影响它能否持续投入。

中国AI公司的资金结构与美国科技巨头存在明显差异。美国大型科技公司更广泛地使用债券市场融资，中国企业则更加依赖经营现金流、股权融资和银行贷款。融资渠道不同，企业承担的风险也不一样。

大型互联网公司拥有成熟业务和资产负债表，可以通过经营收入、贷款及其他融资安排支持长期投资。独立模型公司更多依赖股权市场，数据中心运营商则需要借助银行贷款、资产证券化、房地产投资信托基金和融资租赁。

真正拉开差距的，可能是投资回收周期。

云厂商采购GPU之后，需要通过客户调用和算力租赁逐步收回成本。模型公司持续支付研发与推理费用，收入增长却未必能够迅速覆盖支出。数据中心运营商则需要在设备折旧和融资期限内，维持足够高的出租率。

AI基础设施是一门需要提前支付大量资金、再用未来收入慢慢回本的生意。设备采购完成时，企业承担的财务风险已经形成；客户需求能否持续增长，还需要时间检验。

...

荣鼎集团援引中国信息通信研究院的数据称，2026年上半年，中国新增算力中心项目中，54.3%涉及融资租赁。融资租赁降低了企业一次性采购设备的资金门槛，也让部分运营商能够通过杠杆扩大算力规模。

...

独立模型公司没有同等规模的成熟业务。

一句话总结：2026年三季度，中国 一级市场 “量 ”全面修复 ——单季3,566起创近两年新高；但 “价 ”的分配极度 收敛 —— 45.8%的资金流向1.2%的项目，美元占比与国资占比双双创出新高，市场进入超级项目时代。

截止 日期：2026年9月30日 数据来源：IT桔子 © itjuzi.com

先看总量：2026年第三季度，中国创投市场共发生融资事件 3,566 起，环比增长 22.8%，同比增长 42.1%；

披露融资总额达 4,248.1 亿元，环比增长 4.8%，同比增长 74.3%。2026年前三个季度事件数分别为 2,971 起、2,905 起、3,566 起，Q3 单季首次突破 3,500 起，为 2025 年以来最高水平。

从单笔融资规模看，平均融资金额升至 1.19 亿元，较2025年同期的 0.97 亿元提升 23%；但单笔融资中位数维 持在 2,000 万元，与去年完全持平，均值与中位数的剪刀差扩大至 6.0 倍。

分月看，7 月 1,245 起（1,641.5 亿元）、8 月 1,122 起（1,102.2 亿元）、9 月 1,199 起（1,504.3 亿元），三季度 各月事件数均站稳 1,100 起以上，7 月与 9 月各出现 一个明显的资金投放高峰，市场活跃度呈 “高位平台 ”而非

“脉冲行情 ” 。

一 、市场全景（续）： 一半的钱，流向1%的项目 但总量扩张的另 一面，是结构性的极致分化：10 亿元以上的超大额交易仅 43 起（占比 1.2%），却拿走 1,946.6 亿元，占全部披露金额的 45.8%；与此同时，1,000 万元以下的小额融资有 881 起（占比 24.7%），金额贡献

仅 0.4%。

也就是说，市场的 “量 ”在普遍修复，而 “价 ”的分配逻辑高度倾斜。Q2 出现的 DeepSeek 508.8 亿元 A 轮、Q3 出现的月之暗面 35 亿美元 F 轮、可灵 AI 30 亿美元 A 轮，正在不断抬高市场对 “超级项目 ”的心理预期。均值 上行、中位数不动，是这种 “哑铃型 ”资金结构最直白的数据注脚。

items.snippet:
2026 年上半年，中国 AI 创业公司经历了一场狂热的融资热潮，总融资额突破三千亿元， 仅 6 个月的融资体量已超过 2025 年全年。

AI 融资金额占全赛道约 48.6%，接近一半，事件数占比约 22.5%。

换句话说——2026 上半年一级市场每融出 2 块钱，就有近 1 块钱流向AI。事件数只占两 成多，但金额占了近半，说明 AI 赛道的单笔融资额远高于其他赛道。

辑重仓头部。

行业

验证阶段全面进入规模化落地的爆发期。

items.snippet:
Sand.ai完成2亿美元融资，10个月累计融资3亿美元，跻身独角兽行列

# Sand.ai完成2亿美元融资，10个月累计融资3亿美元，跻身独角兽行列

 作者：王圆磊 

昨天 11:18 

 10 个月内累计融资额达 3 亿美元，正式跻身独角兽行列。 

亿欧11月5日消息， Sand.ai 宣布完成2亿美元A+轮融资。这是公司2026年完成的第三轮融资， 10个月内累计融资额达3亿美元，本轮融资后正式跻身独角兽行列。

本轮融资汇聚了产业资本、知名人民币及美元基金、上海国资等多方投资力量。其中，基石资本、网宿科技（300017.SZ）联合领投；时代资本、国方创投、磐霖资本、东证资本等知名机构参投；天创资本携山东铁投产投、山东铁路基金战略参投；浦东创投等上海国资背景机构加入；经纬创投、华业天成、中科创星等老股东持续加注。

本轮融资资金将主要用于视频基础模型研发、训练与推理基础设施建设、产品迭代及全球市场拓展。Sand.ai 新一代更大参数规模的 MoE 架构视频生成基础模型 MAGI-2 正式版，将于近期发布。

...

Sand.ai（三呆科技）自成立之初便专注于视频生成基础模型及应用产品研发。公司持续探索视频生成模型的技术架构，从自回归生成、音视频联合建模，逐步推进至千亿参数级 MoE 模型，在模型能力和推理效率方面取得了一系列突破。

...

2026 年 8 月，Sand.ai 发布并开源 MAGI-2 Preview，成为全球首个将视频生成模型扩展至千亿参数规模并开放模型权重的团队。该模型采用超细粒度 MoE 架构，总参数量约 114B，单次前向计算激活约 6B 参数，在扩大模型容量的同时控制计算开销，10秒1080P视频的推理成本仅0.5元「蒸馏后模型」。在第三方评测平台 Artificial Analysis 的图生视频榜单中，MAGI-2 Preview 发布时位列全球第六。

...

随着本轮融资完成，Sand.ai 将继续推进下一代大规模视频模型研发，探索开源基础模型与应用产品的协同发展，进一步拓展全球开发者生态与商业化应用。

# Nebuly raises $21M Series A to turn AI investments into measurable results

 Nebuly develops a platform that helps enterprises measure the business value of AI agents by analysing their impact on productivity, operational efficiency and revenue across internal tools and customer-facing applications. 

 Tamara Djurickovic 15 hours ago 

 

Nebuly, a platform that helps enterprises measure the business value of their AI agents, has raised $21 million in a Series A funding round led by Planven. The round included participation from Exor Ventures, Tenacity Capital, TGVG Capital and Fastweb+Vodafone (via Founders Factory), alongside returning investors and angel investors. CDP Venture Capital SGR also supported the round through its Digital Transition Fund, backed by the European Union's NextGenerationEU programme.

As businesses increase their investment in artificial intelligence, measuring its impact on productivity, operational efficiency and revenue has become an important challenge. While AI agents are increasingly used to support employees, handle customer enquiries and automate everyday tasks, many organisations still struggle to determine the returns on these investments.

...

Nebuly addresses this gap through a platform that analyses how AI agents are used across an organisation, bringing together data from employee-facing tools and customer-facing assistants to measure their business impact.

For internal AI applications, the platform evaluates efficiency gains, including time saved and additional capacity, as well as new tasks that employees can perform with AI assistance. It also identifies how different teams use AI, whether it is being applied to high-value activities and where additional training could improve its effectiveness.

# Ukrainian defencetech UFORCE raises $700M Series A at $6B valuation

 Co-led by Valor Equity Partners and the UK National Wealth Fund, the funding will scale production of UFORCE's combat-tested autonomous systems across air, land and sea, expanding manufacturing beyond Ukraine. 

 Cate Lawrence 13 hours ago 

 

UFORCE, a defencetech company founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, with major hubs in Kyiv and Washington, DC, today announced a $700 million Series A financing round at a $6 billion valuation. 

UFORCE builds autonomous uncrewed platforms across sea, land and air, and the AI software, orchestration, and command-and-control (C2) layer that operates them. Its goal is to make defence a hundred times cheaper than offensive operations.

...

Valor Equity Partners and the UK National Wealth Fund (NWF) co-led the funding round, with participation from the US–Ukraine Reconstruction Investment Fund (URIF). The round also drew leading investors from across Silicon Valley, Europe, and Asia, including Menlo Ventures, Xantium, and Hiro Capital. Existing investors, including Shield Capital, Ballistic Ventures, Lakestar, and Squadra, also increased their stakes in UFORCE.

...

The funding round will empower UFORCE to expand and distribute its production capacity across the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Middle East, manufacturing its platforms close to the theaters where they are needed while helping allied nations expand their sovereign manufacturing capabilities. 

This distributed capacity will enable UFORCE to maintain continuous production and supply front-line troops with uncrewed systems despite continued attacks in Ukraine, while bringing advanced capabilities to the battlefield. ​

SoftBank leads $500M funding round in Agile Robots - Tech.eu

# SoftBank leads $500M funding round in Agile Robots

 Agile will use the funds to expand in the US and boost production. 

 John Reynolds 11 hours ago 

 

SoftBank has led a $500m funding round in German humanoid robotics startup Agile Robots that automates industrial work. 

The Japanese multinational led the Series F funding round, which also features Nvidia, Hitachi, and T Capital and valued Agile at $8.5bn. Agile has raised around $2bn in total. 

The Munich-based robotics company manufactures robotic arms, hands, autonomous mobile robots and humanoid robots, as well as building the software and AI models behind the tech.

Its robots carry out work such as assembling products, handling components, inspecting equipment and moving materials around factories.

Founded in 2018 as a spin-off out of the German Aerospace Centre, Agile said it would use the new funds to expand in the US and boost production capacity.

Earlier this year, Agile opened a factory close to Munich, which can make up to 10,000 legged and ⁠wheeled humanoid robots a year, the company said. Agile employs over 2,000 research and development specialists and holds over 650 patents. Its customers include automotive, consumer electronics, healthcare and service industries.

Agile CEO and founder Dr. Zhaopeng Chen said: “Physical AI will fundamentally change how the world builds, moves and makes things. Our vision is intelligent robots working alongside people in factories and warehouses everywhere, and Agile Robots is determined to lead that shift.

"We bring Physical AI out of the lab and into industrial production, across logistics, automotive, electronics and manufacturing. This funding allows us to accelerate our global expansion, strengthen our presence in key markets and build out production capacity.”

# Berlin-LA startup Opdo raises $2.3M to automate optical engineering with AI

 The startup combines AI-driven design, simulation and manufacturing data to reduce development cycles from months to weeks, targeting bottlenecks in quantum computing, aerospace and advanced sensing. 

 Cate Lawrence 10 hours ago 

 

Opdo, an AI-native optical engineering company, has raised $2.3 million in pre-seed funding to accelerate its ambition of automating optical engineering, from initial design to finished components. 

The Los Angeles and Berlin startup is developing a self-improving system that connects AI-driven design and simulation with real-world manufacturing data, and has already demonstrated its ability to reduce end-to-end development and manufacturing cycles from months to weeks. For more than a year, Opdo has worked alongside customers to design complex optical systems, combining AI agents with specialist engineering expertise. Its technology operates within established optical design software, including Zemax and CODE V, allowing engineers to accelerate their workflows without replacing existing tools. Opdo’s own engineers provide additional design expertise, and customers can also source prototypes and finished components through the company. Optics underpins technologies ranging from quantum computing and aerospace to AR/VR, defence and advanced sensing. Yet designing and manufacturing optical components remains slow and labour-intensive, with growing demand for specialist engineers creating bottlenecks across these industries. Opdo aims to overcome these constraints by connecting digital design with physical production. Data from manufactured and tested components can feed back into its AI models, improving subsequent designs and progressively automating the journey from initial requirements to production-ready optical systems. # Biomatter lands $18M to speed up enzyme development with AI

 Biomatter develops a computational platform for designing custom enzymes tailored to specific chemical reactions, helping companies in pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, agriculture and industrial biotechnology accelerate enzyme development. 

 Tamara Djurickovic 15 hours ago 

 

Biomatter, a company specialising in custom enzyme design, has raised $18 million in an oversubscribed Series A funding round led by Astanor, with participation from existing investors UVC Partners, Inventure and Metaplanet.

Biomatter develops computational technology to design enzymes tailored to specific chemical reactions and industrial applications. Rather than modifying existing natural enzymes, the company focuses on creating enzymes based on the chemistry required for a particular process.

Enzymes play an important role in industries such as pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, agriculture and industrial biotechnology. However, conventional enzyme development can take months or even years, particularly when naturally occurring enzymes are unsuitable for specific applications.

To address these challenges, Biomatter combines computational models with laboratory testing to develop enzymes with properties suited to customers' requirements. Its technology draws on a proprietary dataset of experimentally characterised enzymes, which expands with each development programme. According to the company, its enzyme design process currently takes weeks rather than months or years.

Biomatter has developed custom enzymes for enterprise customers across Europe, the United States and Japan, including AstraZeneca, BASF, Sanofi and Tereos. Its technology is also used in commercial products, including an enzyme developed in collaboration with Thermo Fisher Scientific to improve stability for molecular biology and mRNA research applications.

# Czech medtech Kardi Ai raises €5.3M to advance predictive heart monitoring

 Kardi Ai develops an AI-powered heart monitoring platform that combines wearable ECG technology with data analysis to detect potential cardiac arrhythmias, support clinical decisions and improve access to preventive cardiac care. 

 Tamara Djurickovic 11 November 2026 

 

Czech medtech startup Kardi Ai has raised €5.3 million in a Series A funding round led by German HealthTech VC fund Callisto Health, with participation from Česká spořitelna and Slovenská sporiteľňa through Seed Starter, alongside BrightCap Ventures, Purple Ventures, DEPO Ventures and Garage Angels.

Kardi Ai develops a technology platform for long-term heart rhythm monitoring and the early detection of potential heart rhythm disorders. Its solution combines a fitness chest strap equipped with an electrocardiogram (ECG) sensor, a mobile application and AI-powered analysis of ECG recordings.

Traditional cardiac examinations typically capture heart activity over a limited period, potentially missing irregularities that occur intermittently. Kardi Ai aims to address this limitation by enabling patients to monitor their heart rhythm during everyday activities, generating data that can help physicians identify potential problems and determine whether further medical attention is needed. The system does not provide diagnoses but supports clinical decision-making through long-term monitoring and analysis.

In the Czech Republic, Kardi Ai works with more than 70 hospitals and over 20 corporate and employee-benefit partners, with its technology used by more than 6,000 people. According to the company, its monitoring system has identified possible cardiac arrhythmias in approximately one quarter of users, including more than 500 findings classified as critical.

items.title: Anorak secures $5M to let anyone create their own AI-powered games - Tech.eu
items.snippet:
Anorak secures $5M to let anyone create their own AI-powered games - Tech.eu

# Anorak secures $5M to let anyone create their own AI-powered games

 Founded by former Hutch executives, Anorak is developing AI-powered interactive entertainment that allows communities to create games and experiences around their own interests. 

 Cate Lawrence 11 November 2026 

 

Anorak, a London-Chengdu entertainment tech company with the vision of “making any pursuit playable”, today announced a $5 million pre-seed round co-led by Play Ventures and Backed VC, with participation from Supercell and MTG. 

Anorak is led by CEO Shaun Rutland, who co-founded Hutch – the mobile automotive games studio behind Top Drives and F1 Clash, acquired by MTG in 2020 – and Chief Creative Officer Jonathan Alpine, a founding employee at Hutch and its former Chief Creative Officer. They are joined by co-founder Tak Fung, Chief of AI, who leads Anorak's AI lab in Chengdu, China.

 The company, which began as a generative video research project, now has a 20-strong team across London and Chengdu, developing proprietary inference technology to make generative video faster, cheaper and more controllable, progressively enabling games and experiences to shift from pre-generated to generative, real-time interaction. 

The company's medium is interactive generative video – generative video, made playable. Rather than simply prompting its way to new AI-bolstered versions of existing games, Anorak is building new play patterns from scratch, and the platform to go with them. It’s a platform where generated video responds to user choices and inputs in real time. The model pairs human creativity and playfulness with agentic ingenuity and visualisation to establish an entirely new entertainment medium; one that is playable, watchable, and shareable.

...

Anorak is releasing new playable experiments on its blog 

every week, with plans to launch a creator platform that will enable anyone to realise their ideas.

XpertDox’s XpertCoding platform automates medical coding, turning the clinical documentation in a provider’s EHR into accurate, consistent and well-documented coded data.

Coding teams can spend their time coaching physicians instead of working routine claims.

It also flags documentation gaps, helping providers improve their notes over time. 

 Over the last 12 months, XpertDox doubled its revenue, with 126% net revenue retention and 95% customer retention. The company processes millions of claims annually and is expanding capacity to support tens of millions.

# Nvidia's Jensen Huang resigns: what does it mean for the AI industry? 

Carl Franzen

 7:05 am, PT, November 12, 2026 

VentureBeat made with OpenAI ChatGPT-Images-2.6

Copy link Share on LinkedIn Share on X Share on Facebook

Jensen Huang, co-founder and longtime CEO of the graphics processing unit (GPU) and computer chip giant Nvidia, has resigned, according to announcement published by the company this morning. The news follows recent reports from The New York Times that Huang engaged in extramarital affairs with Alice Huang (last name unrelated), a businesswoman at Nvidia customer company Megaspeed that U.S. intelligence believe is a Chinese spy targeting Jensen in an espionage plot, and with a separate subordinate at Nvidia. 

Jensen’s sudden departure from NVIDIA raises a question that reaches far beyond who will run the chipmaker: How much of America’s AI expansion depends on investors believing that its most influential dealmaker can keep the entire enterprise moving? Will Jensen's departure be the prick that pops the potential "AI bubble"? 

The answer matters to companies building data centers, startups developing models and businesses buying AI services — as well as the broader U.S. economy, whose recent gross-domestic product (GDP) growth has been driven to a significant extent by tech, AI and their related data centers. NVIDIA supplies hardware, invests in customers and helps support infrastructure commitments. A leadership crisis at the company can therefore affect both the equipment powering AI and the financing that pays for it.

items.title: Skan AI raises $63 million betting that watching how employees actually work is the missing layer of enterprise AI | VentureBeat

# Skan AI raises $63 million betting that watching how employees actually work is the missing layer of enterprise AI

Michael Nuñez

 4:00 am, PT, August 12, 2026 

Credit: VentureBeat made with Midjourney

Copy link Share on LinkedIn Share on X Share on Facebook

Skan AI, a startup that builds what it calls a " context graph of work" by observing how employees actually perform their jobs across enterprise software, has raised $63 million in Series C funding co-led by Cathay Innovation and Dell Technologies Capital, the company announced Wednesday.

Citi Ventures, Bloomberg Beta, State Farm Ventures, and Wipro Ventures also participated in the round, which brings the seven-year-old company's total funding to roughly $120 million. Alongside the raise, Skan is announcing the general availability of two new products — Skan AI Blueprint and Skan AI Agents — that, together with its existing Skan AI Intelligence offering, form a complete platform for discovering, modeling, and ultimately automating enterprise workflows.

...

Skan's answer is to go to the source itself. The company deploys observation technology on employee desktops that continuously watches how work moves across applications — the spreadsheet, the CRM, the email client, the 40-year-old mainframe — and abstracts those observations into a living model of the underlying business process.

...

The more concrete evidence comes from individual deployments. At one top U.S. bank, according to the company, Skan observed 11.2 million context switches across 1,500 finance professionals and uncovered $37 million in operational friction.

# MGF-Kavachh leads Rs 18 Cr seed round in climate startup mistEO 

## Thiruvananthapuram-based climate intelligence startup mistEO has raised Rs 18 crore in a seed funding round led by MGF-Kavachh, with participation from Seafund and other investors. 

Gyan Vardhan

 12 Nov 2026 16:51 IST

Thiruvananthapuram-based climate intelligence startup mistEO has raised Rs 18 crore in a seed funding round led by MGF-Kavachh, with participation from Seafund and other investors.

The funding was announced at HUDDLE GLOBAL 2026, the eighth edition of the event.

The startup will use the proceeds to scale its flagship Climate Decision Intelligence (CDI) platform for banks, insurers and agricultural value chains across India and Asia.

Founded in 2019 by Samuel John and Ambarish Narayanan, mistEO combines weather modelling with artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning to convert weather and climate data into actionable insights.

Its CDI platform integrates satellite, radar, Internet of Things (IoT) and ground-sensor data to help financial institutions and businesses assess the impact of weather events on farms, assets and loans.

The company’s proprietary forecasting model, Indra, provides weather forecasts at a spatial resolution of 3 km across three time windows: 0-6 hours, 6-24 hours and 24-48 hours.

mistEO also develops solutions for maritime operations, renewable energy forecasting, logistics and mobility, and flood and heavy-rainfall monitoring.

...

In Australia, its livestock early warning system helps cattle farmers prepare for heat stress up to seven days in advance.

...

Incubated at Social Alpha, mistEO is headquartered in Thiruvananthapuram and also operates an office in Melbourne, Australia. It plans to strengthen its forecasting and risk models, expand its team and build partnerships across Asian markets.

## Bengaluru-based consumer AI and entertainment company EloElo Group has raised $80 million in a Series C funding round led by Hornbill Capital and NBCUniversal. 

Harsh Upadhyay

Bengaluru-based consumer AI and entertainment company EloElo Group has raised $80 million in a Series C funding round led by Hornbill Capital and NBCUniversal. The round also saw participation from MIT Investment Co. and existing investors Play Ventures, Kalaari Capital, Waterbridge Ventures, Griffin Gaming Partners and others.

The fresh capital will be used to fund original content across languages, support the international launch of its micro drama platform Story TV, and expand investments in Dolphin AI, its agentic AI creative suite.

Founded in 2020 by former Flipkart executive Saurabh Pandey, EloElo Group operates Story TV, a micro drama platform, alongside Master, a micro learning platform, Dolphin AI and Voxy AI, an AI companion agent. Story TV offers over 5,000 micro dramas across six languages, with a new drama launched every three hours. The platform records 95 minutes of daily time spent per user, according to the company.

The company owns the content, distribution and AI-powered production engine behind its entertainment business. Across its apps, EloElo Group has over 40 million monthly active users and has crossed 300 million installs.

The latest funding round takes the company's total capital raised to $130 million which includes a $13.5 million Series B round raised in April 2025.

EloElo said it achieved multi-fold revenue growth over the past year and has scaled with profitable unit economics. EloElo began monetising in May 2024 and reported revenue of Rs 69.5 crore in FY25, with losses remaining largely flat. Its FY26 results are yet to be filed.

# Bio-tech startup Venomics AI raises $2.7 Mn in pre-seed round 

## Venomics AI, a biotechnology company spun out of the Indian Institute of Science (IISc) has raised US$2.7 million in its first institutional funding round. The pre-seed round was co-led by Speciale Invest and South Park Commons, with participation from 

Gyan Vardhan

Venomics AI, a biotechnology company spun out of the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), has raised $2.7 million in its first institutional funding round. The pre-seed round was co-led by Speciale Invest and South Park Commons, with participation from Operators Studio.

The proceeds will be used to expand the company’s operations, grow its molecular dataset and strengthen its AI and laboratory screening capabilities, Venomics AI said in a press release.

The experimental results are then fed back into subsequent predictions and molecular design.

The company aims to use India’s venom biodiversity and its scientific and computational expertise to develop a drug discovery platform for global therapeutic development.

Venomics AI has established the initial architecture of its platform, joined the NVIDIA Inception programme and been selected among the top five finalists for the 2026 Indo-Boston Biotech Bridge Award.

# Greenjoules raises Rs 150 Cr in Series B led by Amazon funds, secures Rs 100 Cr loan from TDB 

## Pune-based renewable fuels startup Greenjoules has raised Rs 150 crore in a Series B funding round co-led by Amazon’s Smbhav Venture Fund and Climate Pledge Fund. The round also saw participation from Rainmatter, the investment arm of Zerodha, and 

Gyan Vardhan

 11 Nov 2026 16:37 IST

Pune-based renewable fuels startup Greenjoules has raised Rs 150 crore in a Series B funding round co-led by Amazon’s Smbhav Venture Fund and Climate Pledge Fund.

The round also saw participation from Rainmatter, the investment arm of Zerodha, and Singularity’s Strategic Autonomy Fund. Blue Ashva Capital, which led the company’s Series A round in 2021, remains its largest shareholder.

Separately, Greenjoules has secured a Rs 100 crore loan from the Technology Development Board (TDB), under the Department of Science and Technology. The combined Rs 250 crore financing will support the company’s expansion plans.

The proceeds will be deployed to set up a manufacturing facility at Khed City in Pune, with a planned capacity to produce 200,000 litres of biocrude per day from agricultural waste. The facility will be developed in phases, starting in 2027, Greenjoules said in a press release.

Founded in 2018 by S. Viraraghavan, Radhika Viraraghavan, Shweta Viraraghavan and Sethunath Ramaswamy, Greenjoules converts agricultural and agro-industrial waste into renewable fuels using its proprietary Integrated Catalytic Thermocracking (ICTC) technology. Its biocrude is further processed into renewable diesel and bio-naphtha.

items.snippet:
Physical AI vision company Nova Spectral AI raises Rs 21.15 Cr led by Shastra VC

# Physical AI vision company Nova Spectral AI raises Rs 21.15 Cr led by Shastra VC 

## Physical AI vision company Nova Spectral AI has raised Rs 21.15 crore (about $2.25 million) in a seed funding round led by Shastra VC, with participation from Equirus InnovateX Fund and angel investors. 

Gyan Vardhan

 27 Oct 2026 11:40 IST

Physical AI vision company Nova Spectral AI has raised Rs 21.15 crore (about $2.25 million) in a seed funding round led by Shastra VC, with participation from Equirus InnovateX Fund and angel investors.

The proceeds will be used to build a team and develop a field ready prototype within 18 months, the company said in a press release.

Founded this year by Anish Priyadarshi and Sanjeev Kumar, Nova Spectral AI develops lead free colloidal quantum dot (cQD) short wave infrared (SWIR) image sensor chips on standard silicon CMOS for defence intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) and physical AI applications.

The Bengaluru based startup said it is developing an indigenous quantum dot SWIR image sensor chip. The technology enables cameras to capture images in conditions where conventional cameras may struggle, including low light, haze and smoke. It can be used in drones, surveillance systems, robots and autonomous vehicles.

Nova Spectral AI uses CMOS compatible manufacturing processes and indium arsenide (InAs) colloidal quantum dots to develop infrared sensors. The company aims to reduce sensor costs by up to 100 times compared with conventional indium gallium arsenide (InGaAs) technology.

In defence, the technology could expand the use of SWIR imaging across drones and ISR platforms while reducing dependence on imported sensors. The company is also targeting applications in smartphones, wearables, robots and automobiles.

## Creator economy startup Rigi has raised Rs 10 crore from Google International through an allotment of preference shares, according to regulatory documents reviewed by Entrackr. 

Kunal Manchanada

Creator economy startup Rigi has raised Rs 10 crore from Google International through an allotment of preference shares, according to regulatory documents reviewed by Entrackr.

Photo from NatureSelect.ai

Eudora Wang

11 November, 2026

Chinese AI emotional companion startup NatureSelect.ai has attracted more than $100 million in new financing, while ex-Qiming managing partner Nisa Leung’s Aulis Capital has reached the final closing of its inaugural fund.

### AI emotional companion startup NatureSelect.ai raises over $100m 

Shenzhen-based startup NatureSelect.ai, which develops artificial intelligence (AI) emotional companion products, has raised more than $100 million in new financing ahead of a new product launch this month.

5Y Capital, Qiming Venture Partners, SCV, iMPC and HyT Capital backed NatureSelect.ai in the new financing.

Founded in early 2024, NatureSelect.ai develops AI-driven experiences promoting long-term human-AI relationships. Its key products include EVE, a 3D AI companion equipped with long-term memory. Beyond text, voice, and video interactions, EVE can proactively execute real-world tasks, such as ordering boba tea or flower deliveries, bridging virtual companionship with everyday life for users.

The startup is also developing Elys, an agentic social network where user interactions naturally generate contextual memory. Leveraging this data, personalised AI avatars can help users surface high-value insights, build meaningful connections, and explore new experiences across the platform.

Since its launch of Elys in private beta this February, the startup has made progress in optimising the multi-user social memory system, while enhancing privacy protection and improving connection efficiency. Currently, the latest version of Elys remains in invite-only beta testing, with the official version expected to launch this month.

The startup counts BAI Capital, Ubiquant Partners, Eastern Bell Capital, and HSG among its early backers.

items.snippet:
SoftBank, Nvidia back Germany's Agile Robots in $500m funding round
# SoftBank, Nvidia back Germany's Agile Robots in $500m funding round
FILE PHOTO: Robots are displayed at the Agile Robots booth at the Hannover Messe, one of the world's largest industrial trade fairs with Brazil as this year's partner country, in Hanover, Germany, April 20, 2026. REUTERS/Fabian Bimmer/File Photo
Reuters
12 November, 2026
Agile Robots has raised $500 million in a funding round led by SoftBank, valuing the German robotics company at $8.5 billion, it said on Thursday. Nvidia and Hitachi also took part.
The Munich-based maker of humanoid robots and robotic arms said it would use the money to expand in the US and add production capacity, including in Germany.
Earlier in 2026, Agile Robots opened a factory in Fürstenfeldbruck, near Munich, to meet what it described as rapidly rising demand. The site can produce up to 10,000 legged and wheeled humanoid robots a year, the company said.
Founded in 2018 as a spin-off from the German Aerospace Center, Agile Robots employs more than 2,000 research and development specialists and holds over 650 patents.
**Reuters**

items.title: SoftBank, Grab plan $1.85bn investment in Malaysia AI infrastructure
items.snippet:
SoftBank, Grab plan $1.85bn investment in Malaysia AI infrastructure

# SoftBank, Grab plan $1.85bn investment in Malaysia AI infrastructure

FILE PHOTO: File Photo: Softbank Group’s logo at its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan, September 1, 2026. REUTERS/Manami Yamada/File Photo/File Photo

Mars W. Mosqueda Jr.

10 November, 2026

SoftBank Group and Grab Holdings have announced plans to invest an initial combined $1.85 billion to develop artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure across Malaysia.

The companies, along with Petroleum Sarawak Berhad (PETROS), signed joint development agreements for the projects, with a long-term target of establishing at least five gigawatts of AI computing capacity, according to the announcement.

The proposed initial capital comprises $1 billion from SoftBank, $750 million from Grab, and $100 million from PETROS. The funding will be deployed in stages, subject to development milestones, customer contracts, and other closing conditions.

The Sarawak project will receive an initial investment of $1 billion, with SoftBank contributing $800 million, Grab $100 million and PETROS the remaining $100 million.

Grab has an option to increase its stake, which would reduce SoftBank’s holding, although the Japanese group would remain the majority shareholder.

For the Peninsular Malaysia project, the proposed initial investment is $850 million, comprising $650 million from Grab and $200 million from SoftBank.

Grab will lead development as the founding shareholder and bring in long-term strategic investors as the project expands.

Further development is expected to be financed through third-party equity and non-recourse project financing at the project level.

The companies will also seek additional investors and hyperscaler customers to support the development and expansion of the facilities, which are intended to serve governments, multinational companies, and small businesses.

Chinese AI video generation startup Sand.ai enters unicorn club after $200m round

# Chinese AI video generation startup Sand.ai enters unicorn club after $200m round

VidMuse is a paid AI video creation service developed by Sand.ai. Photo from VidMuse

Eudora Wang

05 November, 2026

Sand.ai, a Chinese artificial intelligence (AI) startup specialising in video generation, announced on Thursday the completion of a Series A extension round at $200 million to achieve the unicorn status with a valuation of over $1 billion.

For this Series A+ round, the Beijing-based startup attracted a diverse group of investors representing industry capital, government funding, domestic Chinese yuan funds and US dollar investors. 

Chinese investment firm CoStone Capital and Shenzhen-listed IT infrastructure company Wangsu Science & Technology jointly led the deal.

Multiple investment firms, alongside state-owned Pudong Venture Capital Group and an investment arm of Shanghai International Group, participated in the Series A+ round. Existing investors such as iMPC, formerly Matrix Partners China, CAS Star and HyT Capital re-upped, according to a company announcement.

Marking its third funding round in 2026, the Series A+ round brought Sand.ai’s fundraising total over the past 10 months to $300 million.

The new financing came less than five months after the startup raised over $100 million across two funding rounds. Meituan co-founder Wang Huiwen’s family office Lollapalooza Capital; IDG Capital; Baidu Ventures (BV); and Sinovation Ventures, led by former Google China head Dr Kai-Fu, were among the earlier investors.

Founded in early 2024 by Tsinghua PhD graduate Cao Yue, Sand.ai leverages generative video models to lower costs, accelerate turnaround times and democratise high-quality video content creation for everyone.

12 November, 2026

Norwest, a global multi-stage investment firm with a substantial presence in India, has raised $4 billion for its latest fund to support venture and growth equity investments across the technology, healthcare and consumer sectors, per an announcement.

With the close of Norwest 18, the firm’s total capital under management stands at $18 billion. The fund is the largest in Norwest’s 65-year history.

Norwest invests across the US, India and Israel and has backed more than 750 companies across its venture and growth equity portfolio so far.

In India, it counts food delivery firm Swiggy, SaaS company Amagi Media Labs and aerospace manufacturer JJG Aero among its portfolio. In total, it has backed 41 companies in the country. items.title: 消息称 OpenAI 完成 110 亿美元首期新融资，估值 1.25 万亿美元
items.summary: 北京时间 11 月 7 日，据彭博社报道，知情人士称，OpenAI 新一轮融资已完成大约 110 亿美元的首期款项，对公司的估值为 1.25 万亿美元。据知情人士透露，截至周五，这笔资金已汇入 OpenAI 账户。其中一位知情人士称，本轮融资的剩余部分预计将在未来几周内完成，融资总额最高可能达到 200 亿美元。在推迟首次公开招股 (IPO) 计划后，OpenAI 已与投资者就大规模融资进行了一个多月的谈判。彭博社此前报道称，OpenAI 最初计划以 1.4 万亿美元的估值融资至少 300 亿美元。但随着 AI 股票在公开市场遭遇大幅抛售，该公司随后缩减了融资计划。知情人士表示，参与首期融资的投资者包括寇图资本管理和普信集团。本轮融资的其他投资者还包括软银集团、红杉资本、Founders Fund 和安德森 · 霍洛维茨基金。彭博社此前报道称，一个来自阿联酋的投资者财团也参与了本轮融资。知情人士称，OpenAI 还在与投资银行合作，计划向高净值个人投资者和散户投资者募集资金。OpenAI 最近一次融资是在今年 3 月，当时该公司完成了 1220 亿美元融资，估值达到 8520 亿美元。截至发稿，OpenAI 不予置评。

items.title: 消息称微软不再续签甲骨文 AI 算力租赁协议，重新评估超 800 亿美元云合作
items.summary: IT之家 11 月 7 日消息，据彭博社今日报道，微软正在逐步结束与甲骨文（Oracle）的 AI 算力租赁合作。据介绍，微软此前已决定不再续签相关合同，然后近期开始关闭从甲骨文租用的部分计算资源。这也是微软重新评估数十亿美元云计算合作关系的一部分。知情人士透露，由于微软自身的技术规格不断变化，原先租用的计算资源逐渐无法满足其需求。甲骨文提供的服务器使用了较早一代的英伟达 GPU 芯片，因此对微软而言，这些算力的实用价值有所下降。甲骨文发言人表示，其 AI 基础设施需求依然强劲，其中也包括较早一代的 GPU。甲骨文此前在 9 月表示，部分使用约四年的 GPU 资源续约价格比最初合同价格高出 20%。微软则拒绝对此事发表评论。据彭博社报道，微软与甲骨文的这项合作于 2023 年公布。当时，甲骨文同意向微软提供服务器访问权限，为新版 AI 搜索引擎 Bing 提供算力支持。目前，这项租赁协议的完整金额尚不清楚。当时，微软向主要竞争对手甲骨文租用服务器，被视为 AI 行业算力资源严重短缺的一个早期信号。随着 AI 业务快速扩张，微软还与 CoreWeave、Nscale 和 Nebius 等新兴云计算服务商签署了大规模算力租赁协议，承诺投入超 800 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 5,346.02 亿元人民币），从外部云服务商租用计算资源，以支持自身 AI 业务。不过，微软目前正在重新评估相关合作策略。微软内部部分关键管理人员对新兴云服务商的高昂成本和项目交付延迟感到不满。在决定不再续签甲骨文这项协议的前后，微软也加强了对其他数据中心项目的监督，退出了一些被认为风险较高的项目，并在内部讨论是否继续签署新的新兴云服务商合作协议。同时，甲骨文的云计算业务自 2023 年以来持续扩张，OpenAI 和 Meta 等企业的大型 AI 合同为其带来业务增长。根据甲骨文公布的 2026 财年业绩，截至 2026 年 5 月 31 日的财年，公司云业务收入为 339.89 亿美元（现汇率约合 2,271.32 亿元人民币），其中云基础设施（IaaS）收入为 180.9 亿美元（现汇率约合 1,208.87 亿元人民币），同比增长 77%。与此同时，甲骨文正在大规模建设数据中心并扩充云计算基础设施。随着资本支出不断增加，公司自由现金流承压。甲骨文公布的 2026 财年数据显示，其自由现金流为负 237 亿美元。投资者也开始更加关注公司的基础设施投资规模及其资金压力。相关消息传出后，甲骨文股价一度下跌约 3%，此前的盘中涨幅被抹去。甲骨文股价此前曾于 6 月 1 日触及 248.15 美元的年度高点，随后持续回落。相关阅读：《消息称 Meta 已搁置向 Anthropic 出租 AI 算力的计划》

items.title: 最高投资 100 亿美元：SK 海力士设立美国 AI 投资子公司 Hyaico，崔泰源掌舵
items.summary: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，美国监管机构披露文件显示，SK 海力士已在美国成立 AI 投资子公司 Hyaico Corp，SK 集团会长崔泰源担任董事会主席。IT之家了解到，SK 海力士成立的这家子公司此前暂定名为 AI。该公司将加速全球市场 AI 发展，并寻找 AI 增长新引擎，计划向美国 AI 领域投资至多 100 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 668.25 亿元人民币）。此外，该子公司将通过重组 SK 海力士现有的美国业务部门 SK hynix NAND Product Solutions 组建。SK 海力士总裁宋贤钟（Song Hyun-jong）将出任 Hyaico CEO。

items.title: 《鸣潮》3.8 版本将为索尼 PS5 Pro 带来 PSSR，PC 端开放“资源分类下载”及“资源清理”功能
items.summary: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，库洛游戏今日发布《鸣潮》3.8 版本前瞻通讯，其中「旧梦凋零的百合」将于 11 月 12 日正式开启。IT之家了解到，《鸣潮》3.8 版本将为 PC 端带来移动端已支持的“资源分类下载”和“资源清理”功能（以限量测试形式陆续上线），支持在启动器选择下载全量资源或精简资源。同时，本次更新将为 PS5 Pro 和 Xbox Series X 带来性能优先 / 画质优先选项，玩家可根据需求选择。3.8 更新后 PS5 Pro 版本还将支持 PSSR（PlayStation 光谱超解析度）功能，启用后可通过超分技术，把画面分辨率提升至最高 4K。

items.title: Adobe 向初创企业抛出橄榄枝：免费使用 Firefly 和 Acrobat 等软件，最长 1 年
items.summary: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，Adobe 公司最近针对初创企业推出 Adobe for Startups 计划，入选企业可免费使用 Firefly Pro Plus、Acrobat Studio（包含 Adobe Express Premium）以及 Semrush 等软件，期限为 12 个月。据介绍，Adobe for Startups 计划面向成立时间不超过 5 年，且融资总额低于 1,500 万美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 1 亿元人民币）的企业。在免费使用的软件中，Firefly Pro Plus 是一款创意型 AI 工具，可帮助用户将创意构思转化为图像、视频和音频内容。Semrush 则为企业提供搜索情报和营销相关工具，帮助企业了解自身在互联网上的曝光情况，以及如何进一步优化线上表现。Acrobat Studio 将提供 AI 助手和 Adobe Express Premium，方便企业整理 PDF 文档。Adobe 表示，该计划旨在帮助初创企业尽快建立品牌形象，以较低成本获得更好的软件体验，减轻预算压力。

items.title: 日产汽车声明：警惕冒充日产中国发布虚假召回信息的电信诈骗
items.summary: IT之家 11 月 7 日消息，今天（7 日）晚间，日产汽车通过官方公众号发布声明称，近期，有不法分子冒用“日产（中国）投资有限公司”及相关监管部门名义，向部分日产车主发送虚假召回短信、伪造召回文件，附带非官方链接、二维码，诱导车主填写个人及车辆信息实施电信诈骗。日产（中国）投资有限公司声明：上述短信、文件均非日产官方发布的召回通知，请广大车主提高警惕，切勿点击可疑链接、扫描陌生二维码，不要向不明渠道提供身份证、银行卡、验证码等敏感信息。声明表示，日产汽车始终将保障每一位车主的用车安全与信息权益置于首要位置。官方召回通知绝不会以任何名义要求车主线上转账、付费，或是提交银行卡、短信验证码等隐私信息，全力守护车主的信息与财产安全。日产汽车提醒，如需核实召回信息，请通过国家市场监督管理总局缺陷产品召回技术中心官方网站（www.samrdprc.org.cn）、日产汽车授权经销商或官方客服渠道确认。针对不法分子假借日产名义实施诈骗的违法行为，日产（中国）投资有限公司将保留追究其全部法律责任的权利，也欢迎车主收到可疑信息及时反馈。综合IT之家此前报道，已有多家车企遭遇被不法分子冒名发布虚假召回短信的情况。目前，上汽通用、比亚迪、问界汽车、宝马中国、大众中国、理想汽车等均发布声明，提醒车主提高警惕，切勿点击可疑链接、回复相关短信等。相关阅读：《理想汽车法务部：不法分子假借“理想汽车”名义发送诈骗短信，所称“召回事项”纯属虚构》《不法分子冒充大众发布虚假召回短信，大众中国官方发布声明提醒车主提高警惕》《不法分子以“车辆召回”为名实施电信诈骗，宝马中国发布官方声明》《不法分子假借“AITO”名义发送诈骗短信，问界汽车声明并无所谓“气囊召回”事项》《比亚迪：警惕冒充比亚迪〈车辆召回通知〉的诈骗》《不法分子冒名发送虚假短信谎称车辆涉气囊召回，上汽通用官方发布声明提醒车主提高警惕》《不法分子冒名发布涉气囊虚假召回信息，沃尔沃汽车发布声明提醒用户提高警惕》

items.title: 比尔 · 盖茨谈“亿万富翁税”：贫富差距不能指望靠“慈善捐赠”解决
items.summary: IT之家 11 月 7 日消息，据《财富》杂志 6 日报道，微软联合创始人比尔 · 盖茨认为，向富豪征收类似加州“亿万富翁税”的税款，或许是 AI 时代最合适的办法。AI 及周边产业的企业创始人财富大幅增长，持有这些公司股份的家庭也有望获得可观的投资回报。财富不断积累，也让贫富差距问题更加突出。尤其值得关注的是，AI 会否加剧当前的 K 型经济分化，即高收入和低收入群体在经济状况及未来发展前景上的差距不断扩大。盖茨指出，不能指望富豪靠慈善捐赠解决贫富差距问题。政府应当按照财富水平实行累进征税，再由个人决定从收入中拿出多少钱用于慈善事业。“解决不平等问题，首要责任始终在政府。慈善捐赠毕竟是自愿的，不能指望慈善事业充当社会保障网。”去年年初，盖茨决定把约 1,000 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 6,686.11 亿元人民币）捐给自己创办的盖茨基金会，条件是基金会必须在未来 20 年内花完这笔钱。当时，盖茨称这笔钱是他的“几乎所有财富”。但即便是如此庞大的捐赠，也难以抵消 AI 可能加剧的贫富差距。美联储数据显示，美国最富有的 1% 人群持有全国过半数的股票资产，因此，无论是今年还是未来的股市收益，都会更多地流向这些富豪。盖茨进一步指出：“因此，AI 时代必须改革税制，包括对拥有巨额财富的人和亿万富翁征税。至于缴纳这些新税之后剩下的财富，我认为有一群很有远见的人值得关注。他们年纪轻轻就开始思考，无论是在美国国内还是为了全球公益，‘我怎样才能发挥最大的作用？’‘我们怎样才能配合政府现有的援助工作？’”而在今年 8 月，盖茨曾发表文章写道：“企业雇用员工，需要根据员工的工资缴税；但购买机器人，通常可以立即将购置费用计入经营支出，在税前扣除。这样的税制实际上在鼓励企业用机器取代人力。”因此，盖茨提出对 AI 模型消耗的词元以及机器人征税。

items.title: 李书福称吉利完全认同换电模式，“车电不同寿”的矛盾还没集中爆发
items.summary: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，据观察者网报道，11 月 5 日，蔚来创始人、董事长兼 CEO 李斌与吉利控股集团董事长李书福，在 2026 世界互联网大会乌镇咖荟 · 汽车夜话进行对话。这是双方在 9 月 28 日蔚来与吉利达成充换电战略合作后的首次公开对话。李书福表示，吉利完全认同换电模式，新能源车电池是会衰减损坏的，但一台车的使用周期不止七八九年，这个矛盾必须找到解决方案，“直接换一块全新电池包，太贵；拆解翻新修复电池，成本同样很高。所以换电，就是解决这个问题。”据IT之家此前报道，9 月 28 日，蔚来与吉利控股集团达成充换电领域全面战略合作。双方达成技术、运营、资本全方面合作共识，将联合投资双方充换电业务主体公司，共享充换电技术与标准，共建充换电服务网络。吉利控股集团将以其持有的易易互联 100% 股权及现金 6.4 亿元入股蔚来能源，交易完成后，吉利控股集团将持有蔚来能源 30% 股权，易易互联营运车辆换电业务将并入蔚来能源，蔚来能源将持续提升营运车辆换电网络的运营，赋能易易互联营运车辆业务；双方将共建统一的 C 端换电技术和标准，吉利控股集团将开发面向 C 端的换电车型，蔚来能源将为吉利控股集团 C 端换电车型提供服务。

items.title: AI 公司迄今最大发电设备采购订单：曝 Anthropic 砸 34 亿美元买燃气发电机
items.summary: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，据英国《金融时报》今天（8 日）晚间报道，Anthropic 签下了一份大额数据中心燃气发电机组采购订单。随着发电设备供应日趋紧张，AI 公司开始绕过中间商直接采购，进一步涉足能源行业。报道披露，9 月下旬，Anthropic 斥资 34 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 227.49 亿元人民币），从美国得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥的设备供应商 OnePWR Solutions 手中接下总功率达 1.7GW 的重型发电机组订单。按照已知交易记录，这是 AI 公司迄今规模最大的一笔发电设备采购订单，也反映出科技企业为争夺电力供应，正不断向能源行业延伸。以往，AI 公司通常依靠公用事业公司和专业电力企业供电。但燃气轮机、发电机组需求激增，设备交货期延长至数年之后，资金雄厚的 AI 公司开始跳过中间环节，直接掌握发电能力。据知情人士透露，OnePWR 两年前就向卡特彼勒订购了发电机组，仍需融资才能完成采购。Anthropic 原本打算向 OnePWR 购买服务，后来改变主意，直接接手了 OnePWR 向卡特彼勒下达的设备订单。直接采购发电设备也帮助 SpaceX 迅速投入运营大型数据中心。今年早些时候，SpaceX 旗下 xAI 斥资 20 亿美元（现汇率约合 133.82 亿元人民币）购入移动式燃气轮机。谷歌母公司 Alphabet 则在 2025 年底收购了能源开发商 Intersect。Anthropic 选择了另一种方式：不收购整家公司，也不只是单纯买设备，而是接手多年前、设备涨价前签订的订单。部分发电机组近期就能交付，其余设备也将在未来两年内到位。Anthropic 同时是 SpaceX 的大客户。预计到今年年底，Anthropic 每月向 SpaceX 支付的算力租赁费用将达到 31 亿美元（现汇率约合 207.42 亿元人民币）。

items.title: 苏姿丰：AMD 是一家数据中心优先的公司
items.summary: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，当地时间 11 月 5 日，AMD 首席执行官苏姿丰（Lisa Su）在接受雅虎财经采访时，将该公司描述为一家“数据中心优先（data center first）”的企业。IT之家注意到，该表态发生在 AMD 公布其 2026 财年第三财季（2026 年 6 月 28 日～2026 年 9 月 26 日）财务业绩之后，财报显示其数据中心收入比去年几乎翻了一倍。在与雅虎财经主播 Brian Sozzi 交谈时，苏姿丰解释说，人工智能的落地普及速度远超许多企业的预期。过去习惯按照年度制定投资规划的公司，如今正在更频繁地调整预算，以应对与日俱增的算力需求。对此，AMD 正通过提升供应产能，并与客户协同推进更大规模的系统部署来予以应对。我们是一家数据中心优先的公司（We are a data center first company），这就是我们的定位，而且人们需要更多的计算来驱动所有这些应用。相关阅读：《AMD 2026 财年前三季度报归母净利润 61.08 亿美元，同比增长 116.29%》《AMD CEO 苏姿丰：今年是真正的“AI 推理之年”》
